issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]、駅[えき]で先生[せんせい]に{会[あ]い|nt-homophone}ました。
issues.problem: Could be a chance meeting, so the distractor 遇う (to meet by chance) is an acceptable variant spelling.
issues.action: Rewritten as a planned visit: 明日、先生に会いに行きます (Tomorrow I am going to go and see my teacher); why updated.

issues.jp_before: 空港[くうこう]で姉[あね]に{会[あ]った|nt-homophone}とき、とてもうれしかったです。
issues.problem: Could be a chance encounter, so the distractor 遇う is acceptable.
issues.action: Added 三年ぶりに to make it a planned reunion; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]は朝[あさ]から{暑[あつ]い|nt-homophone}ですね。
issues.problem: Unnatural English ('It is hot today from the morning').
issues.action: English changed to 'It has been hot since this morning, hasn't it?'

issues.jp_before: 熱[ねつ]があったので、{熱[あつ]い|nt-homophone}おかゆを食[た]べました。
issues.problem: The answer kanji 熱 appears in the sentence just before the blank, which gives the answer away.
issues.action: Changed 熱があったので to 風邪をひいたので; English and why updated.

issues.jp_before: 5 速い items (新幹線, 川の流れ, 投手, 時速二百キロ, 雲の動き)
issues.problem: The distractors 疾い and 迅い are dictionary variant spellings of はやい meaning 'fast', so they are not plainly wrong when the meaning is speed.
issues.action: d changed to 早い, 束い, 連い (look-alike kanji with the same reading).

issues.jp_before: 4 早い/早く items (朝が早い, 早く起きて, 私より早く, 夜明けが早い)
issues.problem: The rare variants 疾い and 迅い are dubious distractors; they were replaced to match the speed items.
issues.action: d changed to 速い, 旱い, 草い (or the く forms).

issues.jp_before: 毎晩[まいばん]、寝[ね]る前[まえ]にラジオを{聞[き]き|nt-homophone}ます。
issues.problem: ラジオを聴く is just as natural, but it was missing from the slot's alternatives.
issues.action: Slot changed to {聞き/聴き}; why updated.
